title: 塔吉特上调全年销售预期，转型策略显效
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's just start with target. What signals did you get from executives and the results this morning of this company tries to continue its turnaround effort? Yeah, I think we got a strong signal that
segments.zh: 我们先从塔吉特说起。今早的业绩和公司高管的表态，你从中读到了什么信号？这家公司正努力延续其转型势头。

segments.en: the turnaround is working, that their efforts to improve value, to improve the design element of the merchandising and to have newness in the stores and better in stock positions all seem to
segments.zh: 是的，我认为我们收到了强烈的信号，转型正在奏效。他们提升价值、改善商品设计、增加门店新品、优化库存，这些努力似乎都在发挥作用。

segments.en: be helping. We definitely saw a very good second quarter on top of a very good first quarter. They raised their guidance for the full year. I know there was a big tariff refund in those numbers.
segments.zh: 我们确实看到了一个非常好的第二季度，紧随其后的第一季度也很出色。他们上调了全年指引。我知道这些数字中包含了大量的关税退款。

segments.en: Remove that tariff refund. They still be on EPS, they still be on sales and had a very good really good quarter. So the transformation is working. With all of these companies though,
segments.zh: 剔除关税退款，他们的每股收益和销售额依然表现强劲，本季度确实非常出色。所以转型正在奏效。不过，对于所有这些公司来说，

segments.en: target reporting a $1 billion in tariff refunds, how much of that is being put aside or do you put aside Joe, is kind of a one-term effect that doesn't necessarily factor in or is part of the rally
segments.zh: 塔吉特报告了10亿美元的关税退款，其中有多少被预留出来？或者说，你是否将其视为一次性影响，不一定会计入，还是说这波上涨部分反映了关税退款带来的好处？

segments.en: we're seeing the benefit of tariff refunds? Yeah, no, I think people are kind of looking at the underlying health of the business, excluding the tariff refunds. These retailers deserve to get them.
segments.zh: 是的，不，我认为人们是在关注剔除关税退款后的业务基本面。这些零售商理应获得退款。

segments.en: I mean, clearly they were impacted last year by having to pay those refunds, neither getting it back. So it's not like, I know it's one time, but it's different than a traditional
segments.zh: 我的意思是，显然他们去年因支付这些退款而受到影响，现在又拿回来了。所以这不像传统的一次性支出或收益，这确实是他们去年不得不应对的事情。

segments.en: one-time expense or benefit. This really is something that they did have to deal with last year and they've gotten better at dealing with it. I think this strength in the market today reflects
segments.zh: 而且他们应对得越来越好。我认为今天市场的强势反映了这样一个事实：他们的同店销售额增长了3.8%，这得益于客流量的增加。

segments.en: the fact that their sales were up 3.8 percent in terms of same-store sales driven by traffic that
segments.zh: 同店销售额增长了3.8%，这得益于客流量的增加。
